context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8's single failing check (horizontal overflow at 390x844 on /hub) is now resolved. overflow:'hidden' on styles.root in /app/frontend/components/staarwardd/cinematic-hub.tsx (line 191) is the fix. Both mobile (390) and desktop (1280) viewports report 0px overflow. AWAKEN THE GATEWAYS flow and judge-reset-btn modal both work. Portal preview modes remain by-design simulations (mocked).
rca_of_issue: RCA: the absolute orbitLine element (width:590 in styles) is larger than the 390px mobile viewport, so without a clip on the ancestor it pushed document.documentElement.scrollWidth to ~492px. Fix: adding overflow:'hidden' to the root View clips the oversized decorative ring at the viewport edges (as originally intended visually) and restores scrollWidth == clientWidth. Verified at 390x844 (0px overflow) and 1280x720 (0px overflow).
